HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 22.05.2023 CRL.M.A. 13875/2023(Exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No. 863/2015 registered at Rajouri Garden under Sections 406/498A/34 IPC.
2.

The said FIR was registered on the complaint of respondent No.2 who is present in Court and duly identified by the counsel and the IO against her husband (the petitioner) who is a resident and a citizen of Australia.
Pursuant to the said FIR, the parties have resolved their issues and the respondent No.2 (complainant) states that she has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.

sentences.text: The petitioner cannot be present because of being resident in Australia.

However, his father Sh.
Dalip Kumar Midha, petitioner No.2 who his SPA holder and his mother Smt. Veena Midha are present in Court and are duly identified by the counsels and the IO.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No. 863/2015 under Sections 406/498A/34 IPC. registered at PS Rajoui Garden and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
6. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
It is however made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the minor child in future.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 22, 2023/RK
